mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM customer WHERE created_at >= CURDATE()
mapper.update: UPDATE customer SET is_verified = 1 WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND created_at <= NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT customer_id, full_name FROM customer WHERE full_name LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO customer (customer_ref, full_name, email, country_code) VALUES (#{customerRef}, #{fullName}, #{email}, #{countryCode})
mapper.select: SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS customer_id, full_name FROM customer ORDER BY customer_id LIMIT 20
SELECT customer_id, @rnk := @rnk + 1 AS loyalty_rank FROM customer, (SELECT @rnk := 0) init ORDER BY loyalty_points DESC
SELECT customer_id, full_name FROM customer ORDER BY ${sortColumn}
